native.title: Runbook: disk space on batch workers
native.body: 1. Check /var/spool usage. 2. If report-exporter temp files are present and no job is running, purge /var/spool/report-exporter/tmp. 3. If a release changed temp handling, roll back the release and open a ticket with the owning team (Reporting). Never purge while a job is running.
